messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-dedicated-3' reporting elevated error rate (5.8%) and P99 latency ~2.4s. Paging sara (oncall). Auto-escalation to SRE in 5m if no ack.

sara: Oncall here — taking incident lead. Starting triage. Any recent deploys?

jordan: No prod deploys in the last 2 hours from eng. Seeing spike in tensorize worker errors in logs. Sending tail now.

ev an: (reacts) looking — can you paste the top 5 error traces?

jordan: Copying snippet: ```
2024-11-10T08:12:34Z ERROR kv_cache.go:132 failed to fetch prefix: rpc error: code=Unavailable desc=connection reset by peer
2024-11-10T08:12:35Z WARN runtime: batch worker timeout after 120s
```

ev an: Hmm, looks like intermittent gRPC connection resets between model hosters and serving runtime. Spikes align with autoscaler thrash at 08:10. I can try draining one node and bring up a fresh instance.

sara: Do it. Also, Maria from CS — any customer reports?

maria: A handful of customers reported slow responses and some 500s for embeddings calls around 08:10–08:22. No full outages reported, but one enterprise customer hit a retry budget and logged a support ticket. I'm drafting a customer note but need confirmed impact window and mitigation steps.

jordan: Rolling a -1 change: force node restart on eu-west-2-dedicated-3 and pause auto-scaler for 15m. Command I'm running: ```kubectl rollout restart statefulset/dedicated-serving-eu-west-2 --namespace=redwood-serving```

ev an: I'll also increase connection pool timeouts temporarily and bump replica count by +2 on a different AZ to move traffic.

ops-bot: ACTION: schema change blocker check passed. Notified infra oncall.

sara: Quick status page draft for ops team to review: ```Status: Degraded performance for dedicated inference in eu-west-2. Start: 2024-11-10T08:09Z. Impact: increased latency and elevated error rate for dedicated customers. Mitigation: node recycle and temporary autoscaler pause. Next update: in 30 minutes or when resolved.```

maria: Suggest we also include: "If you see elevated errors, retry after 30s. Contact support and include request-id." I'll turn that into a customer-facing blurb.

neil: Tagging product — wondering if specific model variants were targeted? Could be a workload pattern with long seq lengths that amplified KV cache pressure.

jordan: Confirmed: majority of failing requests are embeddings and long-context chat test workloads from a single tenant. They saturated a shard's KV memory and triggered OOM/connection churn.

ev an: Resolved for now: drained the bad pod, restarted the head, and shifted 25% traffic to eu-west-2-dedicated-1. Error rate trending down to 0.6% and P99 ~1.1s. Leaving autoscaler paused for 20m.

sara: Good — I'll mark incident as "mitigated" for paging, but we'll keep monitoring. Maria, can you post the customer note draft here for review?

maria: Draft customer notification (please edit): ```Hi — we observed degraded performance for dedicated inference in eu-west-2 between 08:09–08:22 UTC. Root cause: a concentrated workload caused KV cache pressure and node instability leading to increased errors. We recycled the impacted nodes and shifted traffic; the service is now performing within normal parameters. Actions we're taking: 1) post-incident RCA and timeline; 2) increase autoscaler stability windows; 3) add per-tenant KV quotas to prevent shard saturation; 4) proactive synthetic checks and alerting for KV eviction rates. No customer data was exposed. If you saw errors, please retry and contact support with request IDs. — Maria, Customer Success
```

jordan: A few edits: change "node instability" -> "gRPC connection resets due to KV eviction pressure". Add an ETA for RCA: "RCA to be delivered within 48 hours."

maria: Updated. Will send after SRE confirms final timeline and owners.

ev an: I'll own the RCA on the infra side; will coordinate with Jordan for model-side details. Preliminary timeline we can publish: ```08:09 UTC — first anomaly detected
08:10 UTC — automated paging triggered
08:12 UTC — oncall acknowledged and started triage
08:15 UTC — mitigation: drained pod and restarted head
08:20 UTC — traffic shifted and error rates declining
08:22 UTC — service within normal parameters, autoscaler paused for stability
```

sara: Handoff plan: I'm wrapping up now and will hand to evan at 08:30 UTC for monitoring and RCA prep. Handoff checklist: current metrics, logs bucket path, command history, customer ticket ids.

maria: Customer follow-up owners: Maria (primary comms), Evan (technical RCA), Jordan (model workload analysis), Neil (product impact assessment). I'll send the customer-facing note once Evan confirms the RCA ETA.

ops-bot: REMINDER: please file postmortem ticket and link to this thread. Template: `/pm new incident-dedicated-eu-west-3`

ev an: Filing the postmortem now and will attach logs + flamegraphs. Expect draft RCA in ~36 hours.

sara: Thanks all — great incident handling. Leaving the channel in a few to let owners take over. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll also schedule a sync with the affected customer tomorrow to walk through mitigations and planned preventative actions.

sara: Closing the immediate paging loop. Last check at 08:40 shows stable metrics.

ev an: Noted. Open action items in the postmortem: [Evan] implement KV eviction alerts and quota; [Jordan] add per-tenant backpressure; [Neil] review SLA implications and notify sales; [Maria] send customer note and schedule call.

maria: Will do. Posting final customer note now and linking support ticket. Thanks everyone.
